nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances in ERC20; mutated by _transfer, _initMint, _rebase, _withdraw and _deposit.

Privileged external function protected only by the financer mapping check; wipes an arbitrary account balance.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller address.
deposit authorizes on financer[msg.sender] before wiping a balance.
withdraw authorizes on financer[msg.sender] before minting an arbitrary amount.
rebase authorizes on financer[msg.sender] before rebasing an arbitrary amount.
financer mapping value decides whether deposit proceeds.
financer mapping value decides whether withdraw proceeds.
financer mapping value decides whether rebase proceeds.
Hard-coded dev address is granted financer privileges at construction.
Constructor writes financer[msg.sender] and financer[dev] to true.
Constructor calls _initMint for the initial 1000e18 supply.
deposit forwards the account into _deposit.
withdraw forwards account and amount into _withdraw.
rebase forwards account and amount into _rebase.
_withdraw increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add on caller-supplied amount.
_withdraw increases the target account balance in _balances.
_rebase increases _totalSupply by an uncapped caller-supplied amount.
_rebase increases the target account balance in _balances.
_deposit overwrites the entry in _balances with zero.

_initMint credits the initial balance in _balances.

_transfer debits sender and credits recipient in _balances using SafeMath.

totalSupply reads _totalSupply.

withdraw parameter account is consumed by _withdraw when minting to a target balance.
withdraw parameter amount is consumed by _withdraw when minting.
rebase parameter account is consumed by _rebase when increasing a balance.
rebase parameter amount is consumed by _rebase when increasing supply and balance.
_transfer sender parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
_transfer recipient parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
_transfer amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
Internal _rebase account parameter is local to _rebase.
Internal _rebase amount parameter is local to _rebase.
